name: imap-mail
description: Manage email through IMAP and opt-in SMTP with one agent workflow: search, read, draft, edit, mark and send on request.

interface.shortDescription: Manage email with one IMAP/SMTP workflow
interface.longDescription: Search and read mail, prepare or edit drafts with signatures and attachments, mark read/unread or starred, and send when requested. One skill includes account setup. Each Mac, Linux or cloud runtime uses its authorized host-owned secrets and network access. Optional remote transport requires separate provisioning.
